phrase.zh: 厚厚的钢壁，让实验走向工厂。
phrase.en: Thick steel walls carry an experiment into industry.

visual.zh: 右侧巨大的钢制装置开口在画面边缘裁切，厚外壁包住浅色内套筒与深暗腔体；左侧留出平静空间。固定件沿圆形边缘排列，细刻线顺着金属曲面延伸。
visual.en: A huge steel vessel mouth is cropped at right. Thick outer walls surround a pale inner sleeve and deep dark chamber, leaving quiet space at left. Attached fasteners follow the circular rim, with fine engraving tracing the curved metal surfaces.

background.zh:
博施与弗里德里希·贝吉乌斯共同获得1931年诺贝尔化学奖，表彰他们对化学高压方法的发明与发展所作的贡献。在哈伯从氮和氢合成氨的研究基础上，博施发展了能承受高压和高温的钢制装置，使工艺走向大规模工业生产。画中厚壁与套筒是原创寓意，不是历史装置复原、工程图或实际尺寸示意；短句为原创。
1931年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他们对化学高压方法的发明和发展所作的贡献。
background.en:
Bosch shared the 1931 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with Friedrich Bergius for contributions to inventing and developing chemical high-pressure methods. Building on Haber's synthesis of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen, Bosch developed steel apparatus able to withstand pressure and heat, enabling large-scale industrial production. The thick walls and sleeves are an original metaphor, not a reconstructed historic apparatus, engineering drawing or scale diagram. The phrase is original.
1931 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: in recognition of their contributions to the invention and development of chemical high pressure methods
